harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired the report bundle’s two symlinks using relative targets. The bundle works both in place and after relocation, and persisted across the mandatory node1 reboot.
actions_performed: Changed bundle/current to point to releases/two.
Changed bundle/latest-report to point to releases/two/report.txt.
Preserved all regular report files and verified unchanged SHA-256 hashes.
Tested a copied bundle in a separate temporary directory.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified recovery with a changed boot identity.
Confirmed Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic remained unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Repair links according to links.tsv and keep them as relative symlinks
evidence.summary: Manifest targets were identified, both symlinks were updated to matching relative paths, and each resolved successfully.

evidence.requirement: Preserve regular files and support relocation
evidence.summary: Before/after SHA-256 hashes match. A copied bundle retained both symlinks and returned the expected report contents.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic were identical before and after the work and reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID fd210619-60fe-4387-869a-76f83390b712; reboot was acknowledged, the node became unavailable, then returned with boot ID 98817ace-941c-4b9f-8eb2-645d0764d998. Links, report contents, hashes, and relocation behavior recovered successfully.
